operations.title: Generic invariant Jacobian H0 rank census
The generic invariant H0 kernel is reduced length one and is not the length-two conormal cell

operations.outcome: At b=0,2,3 and D=12,16,20,24 the invariant cokernel has dimension 4, the even Jacobian map has rank 3, and its H0 kernel has dimension 1; therefore it is not the length-two conormal module.
